description: This file defines custom matchers for Jest testing framework, including various comparison functions like toBe, toEqual, toMatch, and others, with internal utility imports and printing utilities.

methods.name: toBe
methods.description: Checks if received and expected are the same using Object.is, with optional deep equality suggestions.

methods.name: toBeCloseTo
methods.description: Checks if two numbers are close within a specified precision.

methods.name: toBeDefined
methods.description: Checks if the received value is not undefined.

methods.name: toBeFalsy
methods.description: Checks if the received value is falsy.

methods.name: toBeGreaterThan
methods.description: Checks if received is greater than expected.

methods.name: toBeGreaterThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if received is greater than or equal to expected.

methods.name: toBeInstanceOf
methods.description: Checks if received is an instance of the expected constructor.

methods.name: toBeLessThan
methods.description: Checks if received is less than expected.

methods.name: toBeLessThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if received is less than or equal to expected.

methods.name: toBeNaN
methods.description: Checks if received is NaN.

methods.name: toBeNull
methods.description: Checks if received is null.

methods.name: toBeTruthy
methods.description: Checks if received is truthy.

methods.name: toBeUndefined
methods.description: Checks if received is undefined.

methods.name: toContain
methods.description: Checks if received contains expected (string or iterable).

methods.name: toContainEqual
methods.description: Checks if received contains an element deeply equal to expected.

methods.name: toEqual
methods.description: Checks deep equality between received and expected.

methods.name: toHaveLength
methods.description: Checks if received has the specified length.

methods.name: toHaveProperty
methods.description: Checks if object has a property at the specified path, optionally matching expected value.

methods.name: toMatch
methods.description: Checks if string matches a substring or regex pattern.

methods.name: toMatchObject
methods.description: Checks if object matches expected subset.

methods.name: toStrictEqual
methods.description: Checks deep strict equality between received and expected.
